title: The payload of a signed KeyPlan document

KeyPlan.description: KeyPlan is the kind KeyPlan: which keys exist and where they live; id "default".

cache_ttl.description: A duration: one whole number and one unit of s, m, h or d, such as 900s, 15m, 12h or 30d.

recipients.description: The signed list of wrap recipients (0006 "Who may receive a wrap"): the RFC 7638 thumbprint of each node's wrapping public key, base64url without padding, the recovery recipient's included. key@ wraps a data key to these and to no one else. 43 characters of base64url: the loader checks the canonical form of the last one.

slot_map.description: The slot map (0006 "The slot plan", decided 2026-11-04 as D20b): which card slot of each node holds which key, under the publisher's signature with the rest of the KeyPlan. A peer's key@ verifies a PinReleaseRequest and a PinRelease with the public key of the pin-release slot of the node that signed it, and only after its own card driver has verified that slot's attestation (0006 "Touch and PIN").

KeyPurposePlan.description: KeyPurposePlan is the plan of one purpose.

NodeSlotMap.description: NodeSlotMap is the slots of one node's card.

node.description: the node, as its key@ names itself (--node); an address part of at most 64 characters, listed once

SlotKey.description: SlotKey is the key of one card slot. In the YAML payload the byte fields are base64url without padding (RFC 4648, section 5).

slot.description: the PIV slot, two lower-case hex digits: 9a, 9c, 9d, 82 to 95
